text: {"label": "Establishing and Analyzing Stimulus Control","definition": "Basic, translational, and applied work on how antecedent stimuli come to control responding, including discrimination training, fading, compound and relational control, quantitative models, and procedures to strengthen stimulus control.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Focuses on discriminative control of responding itself, not on forming equivalence classes, conditioned reinforcement or suppression, or competing-stimulus assessments for reducing problem behavior."}
